function.name: time_converter
function.description: Converts the local time of user's region to the target region's local time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_timezone.description: The timezone of the user in string format. Example: 'Pacific Time (US & Canada)'

target_timezone.description: The target timezone in string format where user wants to know the local time. Example: 'Eastern Time (US & Canada)'

time.description: The local time of user's timezone in string format (24 hr format). Optional parameter. Example: '15:30:00'

message.content: 您是想了解紐約市（New York City）的現有人口，還是整個紐約州（New York State）的人口？如果有其他特定的時間點或資料來源需求，也請告訴我。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "紐約現在的人口是多少？" which translates to "What is the current population of New York?" They want the current population of New York. We need to provide an answer. There's no mention of time conversion or anything else. So we can just give the approximate population. According to recent estimates, New York City has about 8.5 million people. But maybe they want the population of New York State? The question says "紐約現在的人口是多少？" It could refer to New York City or New York State. Usually when someone says "New York", they might mean the city. But it's ambiguous. We can clarify. But the instruction says: "If you do not have enough information to answer the question, ask clarifying questions." So we should ask whether they mean New York City or New York State. Also, we might ask if they want the most recent estimate. So let's ask clarifying question.
